exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) except for patients with Gilbert's syndrome
Measured or calculated (determined by the Cockcroft-Gault equation) serum creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥ 60 mL/min
Eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status 0-2.
Average QTcF ≥ 450 msec (males) or ≥ 470 msec (females) on screening ECG.
left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) \< 50% as determined by MUGA scan or echocardiogram (ECHO)
Patients with known HIV infection except if:
Symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases or primary lymphoma such as primary CNS lymphoma, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression.
Concurrent malignancy within 5 years (for AML patients, 2 years) prior to entry
Concurrent malignancy within 2 years prior to entry other than adequately treated cervical carcinoma-in-situ
Uncontrolled medical conditions such as hypertension (systolic blood pressure \> 160 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure \> 100 mmHg)
